entries.2d15a4a5b809c7c0: It is a railway specialist trading company that has continued transactions since its founding with the former Japanese National Railways (now the JR companies), and has bases nationwide from Hokkaido to Kyushu. Through its stock function of always holding more than 4,000 items of products in inventory, it shortens the period from order to delivery compared with shipment from manufacturers. With major suppliers, it concludes authorized dealer contracts and agency contracts, and shares sales destination demand information with suppliers, also leading to the development of new products.
entries.2fe15f3046a4507e: Targeting customers other than those in the Railway Business, it handles connectors and electronic components as its main products. It also handles repair and modification supplies for overseas thermal power plants, various processed wire harnesses, power supply units and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥2,502 million.
entries.3683e8c27ead88e9: Its main products are railway vehicle products, and it handles electrical equipment for railway vehicles, body parts, on-board equipment, connectors, electronic components and others.
